name: Tomoe Yukino
source:
A maid trainee working under [url=/c127]Mana[/url], also a ninja.

Always together with two other maid trainees [url=/c137]Ebisu[/url] and [url=/c138]Tatsumi[/url]. They cause more trouble for Mana than helping her in any way.
